title: How to Achieve a Natural Summer Glow

content.text: How to Achieve a Natural Summer Glow

A fresh summer glow is less about adding more and more about letting your skin look like itself. With comfortable hydration, a little warmth and a few lightweight layers, you can create a radiant finish that feels effortless in the sunshine.
Start with skin that feels comfortable

Begin with a gentle cleanse and a light moisturiser suited to your skin. When your skin feels hydrated, makeup tends to sit more smoothly and you may need less coverage. Give your skincare a moment to settle before applying anything on top.
Make sun protection part of the routine

Apply broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher as the final step in your morning skincare, following the directions on the product. Reapply as directed, especially after swimming, sweating or spending time outdoors. Makeup with SPF can be a useful extra, but it should not replace your sunscreen. A healthy-looking glow never requires a tan.

Choose a tinted moisturiser, skin tint or a small amount of foundation where you want to even things out. Blend from the centre of the face and let your natural skin show through. Use concealer only where you want a little extra coverage, then soften the edges with your fingertips or a damp sponge.
Add a touch of sun-kissed colour

Cream blush gives a fresh, skin-like finish. Tap a small amount onto the apples of your cheeks and blend gently toward the temples. If you like bronzer, sweep a light layer where the sun would naturally add warmth, such as the forehead and cheekbones. Build the colour gradually so it stays soft and balanced.
Bring light back to the high points

For a natural sheen, press a small amount of cream or liquid highlighter onto the tops of the cheekbones. Keep it subtle and choose a finish that looks like healthy skin rather than visible shimmer. A little balm on the lips and brushed-up brows can complete the look without making it feel overdone.
Let the glow feel like you

The most convincing summer glow is comfortable, light and personal. Start with a small amount of each product, blend well and stop when your skin still looks like your own. A few thoughtful steps are all you need for a look that feels easy from morning to evening.
